ledger: Dance studio | Wood floor, two black doors on left wall, large mirror on right wall | Same | None
Woman | Standing facing the mirror, visible tattoo on her right arm | Same | Raises right arm
Mirror reflection | Virtual image of the room and woman | Same | Woman's reflection raises the incorrect arm

findings.description: The woman raises her right arm (which has a visible tattoo), but her reflection in the mirror raises its left arm (the arm on the right side of the screen, which has no tattoo). This violates the spatial mapping of a planar mirror, which must reflect the physical movements on the corresponding side.
